primary.title: History of the Peloponnesian War
primary.author: Thucydides
primary.rationale: The seminal work by Thucydides, detailing the conflict between Athens and Sparta. It is a foundational text for understanding ancient Greek history and political thought.

secondary.title: A New Companion to Greek Tragedy
secondary.author: Justina Gregory
secondary.rationale: While not exclusively about Thucydides, this companion offers scholarly essays on various aspects of Greek literature and history, likely including analyses of Thucydides' work within its broader cultural and intellectual context.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to Thucydides
secondary.author: Robert B. Strassler
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive collection of essays by leading scholars specifically dedicated to Thucydides, covering his life, work, historical context, and influence.

suggestions.notes: Thucydides' primary work is his 'History of the Peloponnesian War'. Secondary sources are chosen for their scholarly depth and recency.
